title: A silent upstream trips the plan backend timeout while /healthz keeps answering
notes: Load is POST /mcp, a JSON-RPC tools/call of ultrathink_uplift (the same route as upstream-5xx-breaker). The blackhole fault wraps the plan backend (chaos/faults.ts createFaultyBackend) and rejects with a PlanCompleterError of class timeout once config.timeoutMs (the plan backend's per-call timer, modelTimeoutMs) elapses. A timeout is never retried, so each call reports outcome timeout and is one breaker failure; the breaker opens only at its own threshold (default 5, config.ts ULTRATHINK_BREAKER_FAILURES). Three requests stay below that threshold, so every call reports timeout; raising requests past the threshold would make later calls report upstream_unavailable instead. The harness must enable server planning and present the connector key; this template holds no credential.

arguments.prompt: chaos probe: outline a rollout plan
